description: Keep the final reply in the user's conversational language, 2–4 short sentences (25–60 words): report the verified result and ask ONE relevant optional next-step question about ONE action, not a choice menu. Mandatory missing details take priority. Suggestions never perform actions automatically; respect requests for no suggestions. Saved links let friends join without accounts. If CURRENT received UI context or actual host evidence confirms the same saved plan and last-action module are already open, do not call open_planner again; realtime updates the existing view. Historic context is insufficient. Otherwise open the last-action module with the selected credentials, or honor an explicit opening request. Create a new saved lesgooo plan and its first participant. Returns shareable links, private participant credentials and missing_details. Title and name are optional: omissions use temporary Event/Organizer labels, allowing the requested action to complete before missing details are collected in chat. Explicitly supplied fields are not missing. Existing organizer details can later be completed through credential-bound join_plan and the same plan title through update_event, with data preserved. Does not send invitations or notifications. Service use restrictions: plan creation, participation and edits for users known to be under 13 (or a higher local minimum) are prohibited, including under a nickname. Personal data about known underage children, sensitive medical records, intimate content, card details, government IDs, passwords and verification codes are prohibited planning input. This tool covers ordinary non-sensitive group planning only.

request_id.description: Optional UUID v4 for atomic creation. An identical UUID and identical fields (including omissions) replay the same creation; a changed payload is rejected.

title.description: User-supplied short plan name (max 120 chars). Omitted when unknown; temporary Event label until collected after the requested action.

your_name.description: User-supplied participant name (max 80 chars). Omitted when unknown; temporary Organizer participant until their name is collected after the requested action.
